system_rules.purpose: A unified, premium desk-dashboard UI optimized for ESP8266 320x240 TFTs
system_rules.layout: Grid-based padding framework. 320px width, 240px height. 8px baseline grid. Safe margins: 10px on all sides. Component spacing: 5px or 10px.
system_rules.typography: TFT_eSPI anti-aliased fonts (SmoothFonts / .vlw). Header: 18-24px depending on length. Body: 14px. Small caps/labels: 10px. Numeric values (Clock/Stocks): Monospaced or structured custom fonts 24-48px. Antialiasing over solid backgrounds to prevent RAM-heavy alpha blending.
system_rules.icons: 16x16 or 24x24 bitmap icons (1-bit with drawBitmap) or small antialiased sprites if PROGMEM allows. Minimalist, line-based icons.
system_rules.interactions: Global Swipe Left/Right to change pages. Touch bounding boxes must be padded to minimum 40x40px to accommodate finger inaccuracy.
system_rules.rendering_notes: Avoid full screen tft.fillScreen() except on page transitions. Within a page, use dirty rectangles (fillRect over old text, then drawString). For complex shapes or album art, push to a TFT_eSprite buffer first, then pushSprite to screen to avoid tearing. 15 FPS target for dynamic data updates.
